title: Publisher and sign-off with a Sweet Williams record
summary: University of Illinois published the book; the host thanks her and closes with a record by Lee's friend Sweet Williams.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: So that's what Lee Collins was all about. The book is called, Oh, Didn't He Ramble? I'm still trying to get that. We've been talking for almost 45 minutes. Ms. Collins, I want to thank you for coming by and talking about the book. What publisher is it with?

And the story of Lee Collins. And just to end it off, another friend of Lee Collins, who he played with for a number of years, Sweet Williams.
